paragraphs.text: Dipo Wola is one of Zimone Wola 's fathers on Arcavios .

Dipo is a careful, detail-oriented, and protective parent to Zimone Wola . His meticulous actions when preparing Zimone’s room reflect his concern for her safety and comfort. He is initially cautious and opposed to the idea of Zimone attending Strixhaven , demonstrating his protective nature. However, he is also reasonable and capable of being persuaded, as shown by his eventual agreement to let her attend the school after Zihir ’s convincing arguments. Dipo’s personality traits highlight his deep care for Zimone and his practical approach to ensuring her safety.
